name: Missile spread look probe (in-game test)
description: In-game test only, never shipped: the primary fires the MLS-4X Commando's missile, whose stats give it a 45 degree veer at direction 0 and a curve about its first axis; the code logs the missiles' heading against their launch frame, one PROBE line per check, for the development harness (tests/in-game/README.md).
